summary.headline: The Personnel Board finalized amendments to the Salary Administration Plan and approved an Annual Town Meeting summary handout.
summary.summary: At a brief morning meeting on March 10, 2026, the Personnel Board approved final amendments to the Salary Administration Plan for the 2026 Annual Town Meeting warrant. The changes included clean-up language and a footnote allowing a new administrative cemetery agent stipend to take effect immediately upon bylaw approval rather than on July 1. The board also approved a summary handout for Town Meeting and heard an employee comment regarding budget cuts and morale before coordinating for a joint presentation to the Select Board later that evening.

topics.title: Employee concerns over budget cuts and staffing
topics.summary: During public comment, a town employee addressed the board regarding Select Board budget discussions that included potential hiring freezes or the elimination of Salary Administration Plan positions. The speaker noted that non-union staff feel vulnerable and that employee morale is low. The chair responded that while the Personnel Board has not been involved in discussions about staff cuts and is bound by the plan's framework, members planned to raise the topic of staff morale during their joint presentation with the Select Board later that evening.
key_details: A staff member raised concerns over Select Board discussions regarding hiring freezes and position eliminations.
The speaker noted that non-union municipal staff feel unsettled and unsupported.
The chair confirmed the Personnel Board had not been consulted on position reductions.
Board members agreed to keep employee morale in mind when presenting to the Select Board.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The board addressed procedural business, approving the meeting minutes from February 12, 2026, and adjourning the meeting.
key_details: Meeting minutes from February 12, 2026, were approved 4-0.

topics.title: Employee Transition Report
topics.summary: Town staff requested to table the monthly employee transition report to the next meeting. Staff explained that two appointments were scheduled for action at the Select Board meeting later that evening, which would make the report more complete once acted upon.
key_details: The report was postponed to the April meeting.
Pending appointments include an Executive Assistant in the Select Board office and a Program Manager in the Council on Aging.

topics.title: Final amendments to Salary Administration Plan
topics.summary: The board reviewed and approved the final text of proposed amendments to the Salary Administration Plan bylaw for the 2026 Annual Town Meeting warrant. Updates since the previous meeting included minor textual clean-up and a footnote to Schedule B stipends making the administrative cemetery agent stipend effective immediately upon approval of the bylaw so it can be paid out in FY26 rather than waiting for July 1.
key_details: Language adjustments were finalized across multiple sections of the plan.
Schedule B includes a footnote making the administrative cemetery agent stipend effective upon approval of the bylaw.
The stipend is already budgeted in FY26 and will not cause an unexpected budget impact.
Board approved the amendments 4-0 for inclusion in the Annual Town Meeting warrant.
topics.why_it_matters: Changes to the town bylaw affect the classification, compensation, and stipends of non-union municipal employees across town departments.

topics.title: Annual Town Meeting SAP summary handout
topics.summary: The board reviewed a summary handout designed to outline the proposed Salary Administration Plan changes for voters ahead of Town Meeting. Staff and members confirmed that because proposed changes span 10 to 11 pages of the bylaw, the entire bylaw text will likely be printed in the warrant booklet alongside the explanatory summary.
key_details: The handout summarizes all proposed changes to the personnel bylaw for Town Meeting voters.
Changes span roughly 10 to 11 pages of the bylaw, necessitating printing the full bylaw in the warrant.
The board voted 4-0 to approve the summary handout.

votes.motion: Approve the SAP amendments as outlined in the packet, including making the administrative cemetery agent stipend effective upon approval of the bylaw, for advancement to the 2026 Annual Town Meeting warrant
Approve the handout summarizing the SAP changes for purposes of the 2026 Annual Town Meeting

public_comment.summary: A town employee expressed concern over Select Board discussions regarding hiring freezes or eliminating Salary Administration Plan positions to cut costs, noting low morale and vulnerability among non-union staff.

upcoming.what: Joint session with the Select Board to present warrant articles
Next regular Personnel Board meeting and employee transition report
